flags: PHONE missing: Camp Office (513) 523-1060 (ODNR campground map; 'Campground check in station' on the page). Park office (513) 523-6347.

PIN 1.3 km off: stored 39.5772,-84.7570 is 1.3 km east of the main camp. Centroid of Loops A-G (216 sites): 39.58327,-84.77020 (checked on OSIP imagery; H-R loops run ~1 km north from there, and their ReserveOhio points look hand-placed).

WATERFRONT holds (not waterfront): plotted on OSIP leaf-off imagery, no loop reaches Acton Lake. The nearest open water is the lake's inlet arm on Four Mile Creek, about 180 m (measured off imagery) east of Loop E across the entrance road and through trees; other loops have only creek ravines, behind trees.

Base check: non-electric sites (Loops J-R, most of H; ODNR's map) are not typed tent-only here. All 117 list Pad Length 25 ft on a Grass/Dirt surface; 108 have pull-in type 'Not Applicable' and 9 Back In. A 23-ft rig is within the listed length but on grass with no margin. Electric at $37 is the first paved-spec figure, if AWH wants that as the base. A small thing: the map marks A2, B2, B23 and C42, K13 as camper-host sites.
